description: Tech Lead and primary owner for Postmark and DMARC Digests through major team transitions. Led the 10-month template editor initiative, was technical lead for 6 senior contractors on the billing platform migration, owned billing infrastructure end to end, served as primary incident responder, and ran hiring and onboarding.

Selected for a 16-week leadership development program designed by ActiveCampaign to transition senior individual contributors into people leaders, building practical skills in ownership, team leadership and managing small to mid-size teams.

Built internal tooling that let the L2 Customer Support team resolve issues without engineering escalation, contributing to a drop in average first reply time from 6 hours to 23 minutes. Rebuilt a legacy PHP support console as a React and TypeScript micro frontend, and set up its unit and Playwright end-to-end testing.

Worked on Blue Apron's migration from Braze to Segment for customer data collection, and designed its consent preferences in OneTrust and Google Tag Manager to enforce user consent and ensure GDPR compliance. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve user data flow and analytics accuracy.

Feature development and maintenance on a large-scale web platform built with Ruby on Rails and EmberJS. Reengineered a drag-and-drop onboarding component to improve usability within legacy EmberJS constraints, and supported performance optimization and bug resolution.

Spearheaded the modernization from a Rails 4 and jQuery monolith to a Rails 6 API with a React frontend. Cut data table load times from over 20 seconds to under 8, and overhauled the translation system so new global customers could be onboarded within a week.

Designed the backend for a health tech video analysis platform: a Python and OpenCV solution for detection, counting and motility tracking, a Django REST API, and AWS Lambda pipelines for automated analysis, with CI/CD on AWS CodePipeline. Led the backend project lifecycle, from planning and QA to client communication.
Mentored a group of 5 first-year students from remote regions through IntegraTEC, and presented projects at the TEC Vocational Fair and the TEC Emprende Lab.
